summary: Joy Cipoletti, 60, of Colorado Springs, summitted Ellingwood Point ~3 p.m. Oct 10 via the third-class north ridge from South Zapata Creek (last seen by a fellow hiker above the C2 Couloir at 2 p.m.) and never returned; five-day multi-team search with AFRCC cell-phone forensics pinging her phone at the summit; a Buckley AFB Blackhawk spotted her backpack Oct 15 ~1:30 p.m.; body recovered from below the peak after an apparent significant fall and evacuated by Flight for Life.
location: Below Ellingwood Point summit, South Zapata Creek approach
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue (AVSAR); Alamosa County Sheriff's Office
notes: Occurrence date 2020-10-10 = summit/last-contact date (disappearance-date convention); body found 2020-10-15 ~13:30 below the peak. Out-of-county SAR teams (Douglas, Arapahoe, Saguache, Chaffee South, El Paso, Mineral, Fremont, Western Mountain Rescue, Park, Custer, Teller, Huerfano) + AFRCC, REACH29, Flight for Life, Buckley UH60, DFPC aircraft assisted. Center Post-Dispatch + AVSAR mission page both opened and verified. run-757 merge: AAC 2021 "Fatal Scrambling Fall" account (Crystal Wilson, AVSAR president) corroborates the 5-day search + 500-800 ft fall + Oct-15 Buckley AFB Blackhawk recovery.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Ellingwood Point)
